## Details

<a id="music_transpose"></a>
### [`music_transpose`](../../../../src/music/music_voice_state.asm#L7) `$E100`

*variable*

Music voice state ($E100-$E12D, 46 bytes). music_reset_state copies music_voice_init over it before each song. The arrays of 3 bytes are indexed by the voice number 0-2 (SID voice 1-3).
semitones added to every note; reset to 0 for each song

- **Read by:** [`music_voice_start_note`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_start_note)
- **Written by:** [`music_reset_state`](music_player_e38c.md#music_reset_state), [`music_song_end_action`](music_player_e38c.md#music_song_end_action)
- **Referred to by:** [`music_reset_state`](music_player_e38c.md#music_reset_state)

<a id="music_voice_tie"></a>
### [`music_voice_tie`](../../../../src/music/music_voice_state.asm#L8) `$E101-$E103`

*variable*

Tie flag per voice: 1 = notes are tied (no new gate, no gate off), 0 = normal. Commands $A7/$A8.

- **Read by:** [`music_play_frame`](music_player_e38c.md#music_play_frame), [`music_voice_start_note`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_start_note)
- **Written by:** [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands)

<a id="music_voice_ticks"></a>
### [`music_voice_ticks`](../../../../src/music/music_voice_state.asm#L9) `$E104-$E106`

*variable*

Tick counter per voice. It counts down from music_voice_gate_ticks; at 0 the gate goes off, and when it reaches music_voice_end_tick (a negative value) the next note starts.

- **Read by:** [`music_play_frame`](music_player_e38c.md#music_play_frame)
- **Written by:** [`music_play_frame`](music_player_e38c.md#music_play_frame)

<a id="music_voice_end_tick"></a>
### [`music_voice_end_tick`](../../../../src/music/music_voice_state.asm#L10) `$E107-$E109`

*variable*

Counter value that ends the note per voice: minus the number of release ticks ($FF = 1 tick).

- **Read by:** [`music_play_frame`](music_player_e38c.md#music_play_frame)
- **Written by:** [`music_play_frame`](music_player_e38c.md#music_play_frame)

<a id="music_voice_gate_ticks"></a>
### [`music_voice_gate_ticks`](../../../../src/music/music_voice_state.asm#L11) `$E10A-$E10C`

*variable*

Gate-on ticks per voice for the next note, set by a length command (music_note_length).

- **Read by:** [`music_play_frame`](music_player_e38c.md#music_play_frame)
- **Written by:** [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands)

<a id="music_voice_end_reload"></a>
### [`music_voice_end_reload`](../../../../src/music/music_voice_state.asm#L12) `$E10D-$E10F`

*variable*

End-tick value per voice for the next note, set by a length command (music_note_length).

- **Read by:** [`music_play_frame`](music_player_e38c.md#music_play_frame)
- **Written by:** [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands)

<a id="music_voice_attack_decay"></a>
### [`music_voice_attack_decay`](../../../../src/music/music_voice_state.asm#L13) `$E110-$E112`

*variable*

SID attack/decay value per voice, written at each new (untied) note.

- **Read by:** [`music_voice_start_note`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_start_note)
- **Written by:** [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands)

<a id="music_voice_sustain_release"></a>
### [`music_voice_sustain_release`](../../../../src/music/music_voice_state.asm#L14) `$E113-$E115`

*variable*

SID sustain/release value per voice, written at each new (untied) note.

- **Read by:** [`music_voice_start_note`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_start_note)
- **Written by:** [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands)

<a id="music_voice_control"></a>
### [`music_voice_control`](../../../../src/music/music_voice_state.asm#L15) `$E116-$E118`

*variable*

SID control value per voice (waveform, ring bit, gate bit 0 = 1), written at each new note.

- **Read by:** [`music_play_frame`](music_player_e38c.md#music_play_frame), [`music_voice_start_note`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_start_note), [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands)
- **Written by:** [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands)

<a id="music_voice_articulation"></a>
### [`music_voice_articulation`](../../../../src/music/music_voice_state.asm#L16) `$E119-$E11B`

*variable*

Articulation per voice: 0 = normal (gate off for the last 1/8 of the note), 1 = staccato (gate off for the second half), 2 = legato (gate off for the last tick only). Commands $A4-$A6.

- **Read by:** [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands)
- **Written by:** [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands)

<a id="music_envelopes"></a>
### [`music_envelopes`](../../../../src/music/music_voice_state.asm#L17) `$E11C-$E12D`

*variable*

Envelopes of the current instrument, 6 bytes per voice (voice 0 at +0, 1 at +6, 2 at +12): AD and SR for articulation 0, AD and SR for articulation 1, AD and SR for articulation 2. Command $Bn copies instrument n here; commands $A4-$A6 load the pair of the chosen articulation.

- **Read by:** [`music_voice_commands`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_commands)
- **Written by:** [`music_note_length`](music_player_e38c.md#music_note_length)

<a id="music_voice"></a>
### [`music_voice`](../../../../src/music/music_voice_state.asm#L18) `$E12E`

voice the player works on now (0-2)

- **Written by:** [`music_setup_song`](music_player_e38c.md#music_setup_song), [`music_voice_start_note`](music_player_e38c.md#music_voice_start_note)
